equal_initial_definition: 20% to each of the same five fixed strategy sleeves once at stage start; capital then drifts, with no rebalancing.

inference.hac: Intercept-only Bartlett Newey–West variance with HC1 n/(n-1) scaling; no factor regression
inference.lag_rule: min(n-1, floor(4*(n/100)^(2/9))); fixed sample-size rule, not fit to t-statistic
inference.limitations: No p-value or investment-significance claim. HAC addresses some serial dependence, not ETF/rule/weight selection, multiple testing, structural breaks or small trade counts.
inference.quantity: t-statistic for the mean daily net portfolio return minus matched cash return, not regression alpha
inference.sensitivity_lags: 0,5,10,20 and primary lag, deduplicated and bounded by n-1

interpretation: Descriptive retrospective comparison. All allocations/rules inherit examined history; not untouched portfolio OOS.
